# EUComply

> A free technical compliance scan for websites with visitors in the EU. Enter a URL and get nine checks against what GDPR, ePrivacy, NIS2, DORA and the European Accessibility Act expect of a website, with a suggested fix for each finding. No account, nothing stored. Built and maintained by Mads Holst Jensen (mahoje.dk), Odense, Denmark.

EUComply is technical guidance, not legal advice. The scanner reads the public HTML and HTTP headers of one page and reports what it can see; it does not audit contracts, data flows or internal processes.

## The scanner

- [Run a scan](https://eucomplypro.com/scan/): the scan form and the result page. Available in [Danish](https://eucomplypro.com/da/scan/), [German](https://eucomplypro.com/de/scan/) and [French](https://eucomplypro.com/fr/scan/).
- [How the scan works](https://eucomplypro.com/): what the nine checks look for and which rule each one maps to.
- [Scanner source code](https://github.com/mahope/eucomply-scanner): the checks are open source.

The nine checks: HTTPS and HSTS; a known cookie-consent platform; trackers (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, TikTok, Hotjar and similar) loading before consent; Google Consent Mode v2; IAB TCF; a privacy-policy link near forms; legal pages (privacy, terms, imprint, accessibility statement); security headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, frame protection); DORA operational-resilience wording for financial-sector sites.

## Guides and checklists

- [EU Website Compliance Guide 2026](https://eucomplypro.com/book/): a free 24-page PDF handbook, one rule per chapter, no email required.
- [GDPR checklist](https://eucomplypro.com/checklist/), [NIS2 checklist](https://eucomplypro.com/nis2-checklist/), [European Accessibility Act checklist](https://eucomplypro.com/eaa-checklist/): interactive self-assessments.
- [GDPR fine calculator](https://eucomplypro.com/gdpr-fine-calculator/): Article 83 maximum exposure from turnover.
- [Blog](https://eucomplypro.com/blog/): articles on cookie consent, fines, security headers, platform-specific guides (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce), and uptime monitoring.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://eucomplypro.com/pricing/): the scanner, the guide and the checklists are free. A Pro tier (daily re-scans, alerts, PDF reports, footer badge; 79 USD per website per year) and document templates (from 29 USD) are planned and cannot be bought yet.

## Sister products by mahoje.dk

- [Deskuptime](https://deskuptime.com): desktop website monitor, one-time purchase. Pages on this site under /deskuptime/.
- [Transmute](https://transmute.run): desktop data transformer. Pages under /transmute/.
- [DevNotify](https://eucomplypro.com/devnotify/): GitHub notifications in the menu bar for macOS, Windows and Linux.
- [cleancopy.tools](https://cleancopy.tools), [bugbottle.dev](https://bugbottle.dev), [mahope.tools](https://mahope.tools).
